title: Dragon fight (synthetic, SFW)
premise: Mara and Brick climb to a dragon's lair to recover a stolen bell. Fantasy action, non-graphic, no one is seriously hurt.

R001.name: Dragon's Lair Approach
R001.description: A black cave mouth yawns at the top of a windswept ridge. Hot air breathes out of the dark, and an orange glow pulses somewhere deep inside.

gemini_notes: Keep violence cartoonish and non-graphic. Mara carries a shield and a rope; Brick fights with a hammer.
